$comment: Wave-2 manifest: per-context availability probes. The function matrix itself is derived from src/registry/functions.ts (one registry — rule 8); this file holds only what cannot be derived: invocation overrides for functions whose minimal call needs shaping, the global-variable probes, and the runtime validation-rule probes. Placeholders: {T:Type} resolves to a typed input field on containers that can reference fields, else a literal; {F:Type} requires a real field reference (probe is untestable in containers without fields).

VLOOKUP.$comment: VLOOKUP resolves only custom-object fields, and the match field must be the object's Name field — standard-object references reject with field-does-not-exist.

GEOLOCATION.$comment: A bare GEOLOCATION() has no context-legal standalone position; the pair is probed jointly, conflation marked by taint both ways.

flowValueProbes.question: Wave-3: HTMLENCODE's exact entity set — angle brackets, ampersand, both quote kinds (flows are its only runtime-observable home).
Wave-3: JSENCODE's exact escapes (double quote, apostrophe; a literal backslash is a flow-formula syntax error, so it cannot be probed here).
Wave-3: JSINHTMLENCODE composition order and entity set.
Wave-3: URLENCODE — space as %20 or +, and which reserved characters escape.
Wave-3: div-by-zero surfacing in a running flow — interview error or null?
Wave-3: BR() rendering seen from a flow interview (cross-check the formula-field probe).

fieldUpdateProbes.question: Channel canary: a gated rule's field update must write into the record before readback.
Wave-4: div-by-zero in an executing field update — blocked save, silent skip, or null write? (FF: #Error!; VR: blocked save; flow: null.)
Wave-4: which blank mode does a field-update formula execute under — blank+5 = 5 (zero mode) or null (blank mode)?
Wave-4: blank text = "" inside an executing field update (FF and VR: true).
Wave-4: text = case sensitivity at field-update runtime.

approvalRuntimeProbes.question: Channel canary: a gated always-true entry criteria must accept the submission.

interpret.SUBMITTED: channel sound — gated active processes are entered and the submit result is readable
interpret.NO_PROCESS: CHANNEL BROKEN — do not trust any approval runtime verdict from this run

approvalRuntimeProbes.question: False control: how a provably-false entry criteria reports, so criteria-false can be told apart from criteria-errored.

interpret.NO_PROCESS: a false entry criteria surfaces as NO_APPLICABLE_PROCESS — the baseline every other entry probe is read against
interpret.SUBMITTED: CHANNEL BROKEN — a false criteria was entered; the gate is not discriminating

approvalRuntimeProbes.question: Wave-6: div-by-zero in an executing entry criteria — blocked submit, thrown exception, or silently criteria-false? (FF: #Error!; VR: blocked save; flow: null.)

interpret.NO_PROCESS: the runtime error is swallowed and the criteria reads as false — indistinguishable from ae_false
interpret.EXCEPTION: the error surfaces as its own submit failure
interpret.REFUSED: the submit was refused with a non-NO_APPLICABLE_PROCESS error (capture the status code)

approvalRuntimeProbes.question: Wave-6: which blank mode does an entry criteria execute under — blank + 5 = 5 (zero mode) or blank (blank mode)?

interpret.SUBMITTED: blank Number reads as 0 — zero-mode arithmetic
interpret.NO_PROCESS: blank + 5 is not 5 — blank-mode arithmetic (confirm against ae_blank_add_null)

approvalRuntimeProbes.question: Wave-6: the positive half of the blank-mode question — is blank + 5 itself blank? Exactly one of this and ae_blank_add must submit.

interpret.NO_PROCESS: blank + 5 is a number — zero-mode arithmetic

approvalRuntimeProbes.question: Wave-6: does a blank Text field equal "" in an executing entry criteria (formula fields and validation rules: true)?

interpret.SUBMITTED: blank text coerces to "" — same as formula fields and validation rules
interpret.NO_PROCESS: blank text does NOT equal "" here — differs from formula fields

approvalRuntimeProbes.question: Wave-6: text = case sensitivity in an executing entry criteria (formula fields: case-sensitive, org-verified).
Channel canary: an always-true step criteria must produce a work item (Pending).

interpret.SUBMITTED: read instanceStatus/workitems — Pending with 1 work item means the step was entered

approvalRuntimeProbes.question: False control: a provably-false step criteria under ifCriteriaNotMet=ApproveRecord, so step-skipped can be told apart from step-errored.

interpret.SUBMITTED: read instanceStatus/workitems — Approved with 0 work items is the skip baseline

approvalRuntimeProbes.question: Wave-6: div-by-zero in an executing step criteria — thrown exception, or silently criteria-false (step skipped)?

interpret.REFUSED: the submit was refused with the org's own error (capture the status code) — the step criteria did not read as false
interpret.EXCEPTION: the error surfaces as an Apex exception rather than a save result
interpret.SUBMITTED: compare instanceStatus/workitems against as_false: Approved/0 means the error read as false, Pending/1 means it read as true

approvalRuntimeProbes.question: Wave-6: which blank mode does a step criteria execute under?

interpret.SUBMITTED: Pending/1 means blank reads as 0 (zero mode); Approved/0 means blank-mode arithmetic

approvalRuntimeProbes.question: Wave-6: the positive half of the step blank-mode question. Exactly one of this and as_blank_add must reach the step.

interpret.SUBMITTED: Pending/1 means blank + 5 is blank (blank mode); Approved/0 means zero mode

approvalRuntimeProbes.question: Wave-6: blank Text = "" inside an executing step criteria.

interpret.SUBMITTED: Pending/1 means blank text coerces to ""; Approved/0 means it does not

approvalRuntimeProbes.question: Wave-6: text = case sensitivity inside an executing step criteria.

interpret.SUBMITTED: Pending/1 means case-INsensitive; Approved/0 means case-sensitive

approvalRuntimeProbes.question: Wave-8: does AND short-circuit past a runtime error in entry criteria (VR: yes)? Isolated object — if evaluation is eager, this criteria would poison every other submission on it.

interpret.NO_PROCESS: AND short-circuits — the false first operand ends evaluation and the criteria reads false
interpret.REFUSED: eager evaluation — the div-by-zero fires despite the false first operand

approvalRuntimeProbes.question: Wave-8: does OR short-circuit past a runtime error in entry criteria (VR: yes)?

interpret.SUBMITTED: OR short-circuits — the true first operand accepts without evaluating the error

approvalRuntimeProbes.question: Wave-8: AND short-circuit in step criteria — compare against as_false's Approved/0 skip baseline.

interpret.SUBMITTED: read instanceStatus/workitems: Approved/0 means the criteria short-circuited to false (step skipped)
interpret.REFUSED: eager evaluation — the error blocks the submit

approvalRuntimeProbes.question: Wave-8: OR short-circuit in step criteria.

interpret.SUBMITTED: Pending/1 means the criteria short-circuited to true (step entered)

runtimeProbes.question: Channel canary: a gated always-true rule must block its own record's insert with our marker message.

interpret.FIRED: channel sound — gated rules fire and the marker survives into the DML error
interpret.SAVED: CHANNEL BROKEN — do not trust any runtime verdict from this run

runtimeProbes.question: Is text = case-sensitive in the validation-rule context (formula fields: yes, org-verified)?

interpret.FIRED: case-INsensitive in validation rules — differs from formula fields

runtimeProbes.question: Does a blank Number compare like 0 in validation rules (which blank mode does the VR context behave as)?

interpret.SAVED: ordering vs blank is false (blank-mode behavior)

runtimeProbes.question: Is blank Number = 0 true in validation rules?

interpret.SAVED: blank numeric = 0 is false (blank-mode behavior, matches corpus three-valued rule)

runtimeProbes.question: Does a blank Text field equal "" in validation rules (formula fields: true, corpus-verified)?

interpret.FIRED: blank text coerces to "" — same as formula fields
interpret.SAVED: blank text does NOT equal "" here — differs from formula fields

runtimeProbes.question: Sanity: ISBLANK on an empty Number fires in a validation rule.

interpret.SAVED: ISBLANK(blank) false in VRs — investigate before trusting blank probes

runtimeProbes.question: How does a runtime #Error! surface in a validation rule: blocked save with a system error, silently false, or rule fired?

interpret.ERR: runtime error surfaces as its own DML failure (capture the message text)
interpret.SAVED: the error is swallowed and the rule is treated as false/skipped

runtimeProbes.question: Does IFERROR catch a div-by-zero inside a validation rule (it is unavailable in formula fields — org-verified)?

interpret.FIRED: IFERROR catches the error and returns the fallback TRUE — rule fires
interpret.SAVED: IFERROR did not catch (or evaluated false)
interpret.ERR: error propagates through IFERROR — it does not catch div-by-zero here

runtimeProbes.question: Does AND short-circuit past a runtime error in its second operand? (Only meaningful if err_divzero shows errors surface.)

interpret.SAVED: AND(FALSE, …) never evaluates the erroring operand (short-circuit) — or errors read as false; disambiguate via err_divzero
interpret.ERR: AND evaluates operands eagerly — the error escapes even under a FALSE guard

runtimeProbes.question: Does OR short-circuit past a runtime error once TRUE is decided?

interpret.FIRED: OR(TRUE, …) fires without evaluating the erroring operand (short-circuit)
interpret.ERR: OR evaluates operands eagerly — the error escapes despite the TRUE
interpret.SAVED: OR(TRUE, …) neither fired nor errored?! — investigate
